frontend; the native `ctx.goa"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"ls` service, session projection and race-fenced
goal-round driver remain installed on the host."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"The replacement exposes `get_goal`, `start_goal`, and `update_goal`. `start_goal`

turn calls `get_goal`. It captures obje"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"ctive, constraints, milestones,

goal service immediately, and returns to the same model turn so work continues.

Harness behavior."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Worker failures are reported only when the native continuable child has actually
